characters.name: Zei
characters.age: teen (final year of high school, about 17-18)
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego chapters (full name Zei Leimin). Very bright maths/physics mind, quick and articulate, dry humour, nonchalant about danger, competitive Minpentai player; socially a bit awkward. Devoted to his mother Min.

characters.name: Bai
characters.age: teen (same age as Zei, final year of high school)
characters.voice_notes: Zei's Minpentai rival (full name Bai Jahen). Confident, taunting, proud and well-travelled; softens into grudging respect and an obvious fondness for Zei.

characters.name: Min
characters.voice_notes: Zei's mother. Cheerful, grateful, easily delighted; on her first trip abroad.

characters.name: lecture narrator
characters.voice_notes: Recorded educational lecture playing on a screen at the Freetown Economics Institute; even, explanatory documentary voice. Cut off mid-sentence.

characters.name: Seila
characters.age: adult (age not stated; Gladias's wife, roughly his age)
characters.voice_notes: Warm, upbeat, curious and encouraging; a blogger on economics and culture. Wife of Gladias, mother of Zven and Lily. Travels to Freetown and then Iptak.

characters.name: Jahn
characters.voice_notes: Seila's local friend in Freetown; friendly, informed, asks concerned questions about Dzego.

characters.name: Gladias
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Veridia chapters. Thoughtful, calm, gentle, philosophical, with an occasional mischievous streak; a little awkward under pressure. Acolyte of the Order of Steering (accepted as a Keeper in ch. 8). Husband of Seila, father of Zven and Lily. Many of his lines are subvocalised whispers through a neck band.

notes: No letter is shared within the chapter. M here is Min, Zei's mother (not Mu or Mov). L (5:52-5:54) is a recorded lecture on a screen. S in 5:59 and 5:60 is tagged only as an unnamed woman and is Seila (named at 5:63). The last scene (5:99 onward) is a video call: Gladias is heard through Seila's watch.
